say:1:1130905001:1.text: Of course I was afraid... I'm a merchant, not an adventurer! I have no desire to die in a place like this!
say:1:1130905001:1.source_cn: 肯定呀……我可不想把命搭在这地方，我们是商人，不是冒险家。

say:2:1130905002:1.text: Still, danger and opportunity go hand-in-hand. The Maulers in the Crimson Highlands must be busy rebuilding their homes, which means they'll need plenty of materials!
say:2:1130905002:1.source_cn: 不过，这事既是危险也是机遇。现在深红高原上的蛮血应该都...

say:3:1130905003:1.text: I need to go back and restock my wares before someone else beats me to a profit!
say:3:1130905003:1.source_cn: 我得赶紧回去进点货，不能让别人抢了先！
